module_summary: Four-requester round-robin arbiter: a rotating one-hot priority pointer masks a doubled request vector to pick a grant, which is held (locked) until the owner releases, then priority rotates past it.

anchors.name: n13_fef

anchors.name: n2_56e
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector driven to grant output, held while locked.

anchors.name: n11_e63
anchors.why: One-hot round-robin priority pointer, rotated past the granted requester on release.

anchors.name: n12_d11
anchors.why: Grant-locked flag; freezes grant while set, cleared on release.

anchors.name: n5_bc1
anchors.why: Release/done from grant owner; unlocks, rotates priority, clears grant.

anchors.name: n1_c30
anchors.why: Priority-masked doubled request selecting first requester at or after pointer.
